PharmaceuticalFaq2.title: Answers for Procurement and Clinical Teams
PharmaceuticalFaq2.subtitle: Everything you need to know about our cGMP certifications, technical dossiers, and institutional supply agreements.
PharmaceuticalFaq2.supportCaption: Need a Certificate of Analysis or custom formulation brief? Our Medical Affairs desk responds within one business day.

items.question: Which regulatory certifications do Virexa manufacturing sites hold?
items.answer: All Virexa formulation and sterile fill-finish facilities operate in compliance with WHO-GMP, EU-GMP, and US FDA cGMP guidelines, alongside ISO 9001 and ISO 13485 quality management certifications.

items.question: How can hospital procurement teams request Certificates of Analysis (CoA)?
items.answer: Institutional buyers and licensed distributors can request batch-specific CoAs, Material Safety Data Sheets, and Drug Master File access letters directly through our Medical Affairs contact form below.

items.question: Do you support custom contract manufacturing and clinical trial packaging?
items.answer: Yes. Our CDMO division provides small-batch clinical trial supplies, comparator blinding, lyophilization cycle development, and commercial-scale blister or vial packaging.

items.question: How is cold-chain integrity maintained during international shipping?
items.answer: Temperature-sensitive biologics and injectables ship in validated passive thermal containers equipped with calibrated NIST-traceable data loggers monitoring 2°C to 8°C conditions door-to-door.
